reports.title: IDEXX Laboratories Announces Third Quarter Results

lines: The Company is updating its full year revenue growth guidance range to $4,741 million - $4,767 million, or reported growth of 10.1% - 10.8%, an increase of $32 million at midpoint, including $5 million related to the recent CoVet acquisition.

The Company lowered its full year reported operating margin outlook to 32.1% - 32.3%, bringing the projected full year operating profit margin expansion to 50 - 70 basis points as reported and on a comparable basis.

Projected 2026 comparable operating margin expansion outlined in the 2026 Growth and Financial Performance Outlook section of this earnings release reflects the following adjustments: (i) full year 2026 reported operating margin adjusted for a $5 million unfavorable impact of loss on an equity investment;

Projected 2026 comparable EPS growth outlined in the 2026 Growth and Financial Performance Outlook section of this earnings release reflects the following adjustments: (i) adjustment to projected full year 2026 reported EPS for estimated positive year-over-year foreign currency exchange rate change impact of $0.25 at noted exchange rates;
